scripts.dev: bash -lc 'unset POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_PATH VIRTUAL_ENV; poetry run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'
scripts.build: bash -lc 'unset POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_PATH VIRTUAL_ENV; poetry run python -m scripts.export_requirements'
scripts.lint: bash -lc 'unset POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_PATH VIRTUAL_ENV; poetry install --no-interaction && poetry run python -m ruff check .'
